priorFailedInferenceAttempts.failure: The launcher mounted its own telemetry in the model output directory; run-vl.py stopped before PaddleOCRVL construction or any PDF prediction.

cuda.failureBehavior: Abort before any PDF prediction on CPU/fallback or device mismatch.

repetitions.selection: Always score repetition 1. Repetition 2 reports semantic/Markdown stability only; never choose an output by gold score.

readingOrder.ordering: Vendor parsing_res_list order per page, pages sorted by page_index; no cross-page restructure_pages.

pageCoverage.source: Poppler pdfinfo 26.07.0 against the exact SHA-256-pinned source PDFs

projection.oldPlain: Same frozen original Paddle parser text projection; HTML table rows are flattened to tab-separated cells and paragraphs remain in parser block order.
projection.vlPlain: Same adapter as old Paddle; HTML table rows flattened to tab-separated cells, blocks in parser reading order, and page text concatenated with one newline separator.
projection.table: Apply the unchanged ocr-table-row-v1 profile to both parser tables; literal cells/spans only, no language dictionaries, column shifts, gold lookups, or value repairs.
projection.adapterParity: adapter-parity.log verifies that the same adapter reproduces both prior Paddle documents exactly before new OCR inference.

costs.hostGpuSampling: run-vl.ps1 samples host nvidia-smi every second during both phases. The CSV is whole-device host VRAM including unrelated processes and is resource context, not strict process attribution; do not subtract an idle baseline as exact candidate VRAM.
costs.containerRam: run-vl.py records cgroup peak memory; its teardown nvidia-smi snapshot is not peak evidence. Parser wall time is separate from native pipeline time.
costs.crossDevice: Existing Paddle parser was CPU; VL is GPU. Do not claim a causal parser speedup from these unlike devices.

blindness.inference: Network none; read-only model cache; read-only mount containing exactly economy.pdf and population.pdf; no gold, questions, answers, baseline OCR text, or evaluation code.
